answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 51931 Country: India Title: Regarding Jumuah Namaz in College Campus Question: Please give me suggestion regarding Jumuah salah in College Campus. The mosque distance from the college is 2 to 3 KM and approx 150 students studying are Muslims. Please give me fatwa regarding Jumuah salah in college campus. Answer ID: 51931 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 643/643/M=05/1435) If the said college is situated in the city or on the outskirt of the city then you may establish Jumuah salah in the college. The availability of mosque is not a condition for the validity of Jumuah salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
